# Invitation
{: .no_toc }

Accept or decline an organization invitation.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ORG-09` |
| **Route** | `/orgs/:orgId/invitation` · deep link `substratal://orgs/:orgId/invitation` |
| **Where** | Personal › Organizations |
| **Who can use it** | Invited user |
| **Kind** | confirm |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwAlertDialog` (`extra-child` for fields) |

**How you get here:** Invitation banner on APP-01; ORG-01 pending section; `account.organization_invitation` notification (NTF-01 / push action "Accept")

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Org name + inviter | text | Organization |  | GtkLabel |
| Accept | primary-button |  |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Decline | button |  |  | GtkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Accept | `POST /organizations/{id}/members/me/accept` | 200 → ORG-03; apps granted via org (and the org's Standard subscription, if it covers the member) appear on APP-01. Mark the related notification read. |
| Decline | `DELETE /organizations/{id}/members/me` |  |
